checklist.text: Half-res copy pass of scene.color, restricted to water's own screen rect (Law 6 — bounded cost), taken from the PREVIOUS frame — water draws inside the pass that writes scene.color, so a same-pass read is undefined behaviour.
Reproject the copied UV by the camera delta between frames so panning doesn't smear the grab (one-frame latency — the same price every screen-space reflection ships with).
Offset the sample UV by the wave normal x strength, reusing tier 2's existing surface-field normal rather than a new fetch.

Validate every tap against buf:scene.depth's rank: a tap landing on something ABOVE the water falls back to the un-refracted centre UV (the classic foreground-smear artifact V2's own checklist named 'tap validation').
Chromatic fringe: +/-1 texel R/B channel split, gated to the top (quality+) tier only.
Add the real tier entry (n: 5, name: 'refraction', fromProfile: 'quality', cost.class C5 for the read + a separate accounted C6 for the half-res copy) to WATER.tiers, moving it out of deferredRungs.

Bench via tools/shader-lab/bench-water.js and the water test suite; final confirmation is Ingram's own eyes in live Foundry, per the covenant — this checklist item is 'ready for your look', never 'done' on its own.
